sources.title: README.md · qualcomm/Mobile-VIT at main - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: MobileVit is a machine learning model that can classify images from the Imagenet dataset. It can also be used as a backbone in building more complex models for specific use cases. This model is an implementation of Mobile-VIT found here. This repository provides scripts to run Mobile-VIT on Qualcomm® devices.
